cae83572032471.s: How many new All India Institutes of Ayurveda were provided for in the AYUSH measures for 2026–27?
cae83572032471.x: Three new All India Institutes of Ayurveda were provided for in 2026–27.

ca9713a9486c8c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's adolescent mental-health context?
o: India has fewer than 10,000 psychiatrists for more than 1.4 billion people
India has more than 800 million internet users
About 20% of adolescents have diagnosable mental-health conditions
Tele-MANAS is part of the recognised policy response
ca9713a9486c8c.x: The National Mental Health Survey puts adolescents with diagnosable conditions at 7–10%, not 20%. The other statements are correct.

ca577d3aff997a.s: Each year, more than how many newborns in India die from resistant sepsis?
ca577d3aff997a.x: More than 50,000 newborns die every year in India from antibiotic-resistant sepsis.

ca2764fbbabf74.s: How much was provided for Centres of Excellence for AI education, linked to the SOAR initiative?
ca2764fbbabf74.x: ₹500 crore was provided for Centres of Excellence for AI education; the President attended the SOAR event.

cae3076c94727f.s: DAY-NRLM is a centrally sponsored scheme under which Ministry?
cae3076c94727f.x: DAY-NRLM is a centrally sponsored scheme of the Ministry of Rural Development.

ca193f33fa94c0.s: Maiya Samman Yojana, a women-oriented DBT scheme, belongs to which State?
ca193f33fa94c0.x: Maiya Samman Yojana is Jharkhand's scheme; Ladli Laxmi is of Madhya Pradesh, Ladki Bahin of Maharashtra and Mukhyamantri Mahila Rozgar of Bihar.

ca1372ed48e70b.s: PM VIKAS, the Central Sector scheme of the Ministry of Minority Affairs, combines skilling with:
o: Loans up to ₹15 lakh for entrepreneurs
ca1372ed48e70b.x: PM VIKAS (Pradhan Mantri Virasat Ka Samvardhan) combines skilling with heritage promotion for six minorities. The others describe PM-SURAJ, NAMASTE and PMAY-G.

ca971ea08a9727.s: Rajasthan made daily newspaper reading of at least how many minutes mandatory in government schools (January 2026)?
ca971ea08a9727.x: Rajasthan prescribed at least 10 minutes of daily newspaper reading in government schools.

ca9f78d13bd30b.s: The Sarada Act against child marriage was passed in:
ca9f78d13bd30b.x: The Sarada Act dates to 1929. The Age of Consent Act was 1891, and the prescribed ages were raised in 1948 and 1978.

ca6206e62c9e44.s: The Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana completed how many years on 1 January 2026?
ca6206e62c9e44.x: PMMVY, launched on 1 January 2017, completed nine years on 1 January 2026.

ca1483d77b293a.s: Nominal rural wage growth of only 3.6–6.4% a year during 2015–25 was reported by the:
ca1483d77b293a.x: The 3.6–6.4% annual nominal rural wage growth figure came from the Labour Bureau, not the World Bank.

ca018633086f6c.s: Which of the following is NOT part of the policy response recognised for adolescent mental health in India?
o: Ayushman Bharat Health and Wellness Centres
ca018633086f6c.x: TKDL is a traditional-knowledge database, not a mental-health measure. NMHP, Tele-MANAS and Ayushman Bharat HWCs are part of the response.

ca9c9e97ac9f84.s: The Kyasanur Forest Disease season peaks during:
ca9c9e97ac9f84.x: The KFD season starts in October–November and peaks in January–April; KFD has no human-to-human transmission.

caf5c7eb1f1b17.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about ageing in India?
o: The 60+ share is projected to rise from 10% to about 20% by 2050
NPS Vatsalya was a scheme cited in the discussion on ageing
NP-NCD was a scheme cited in the discussion on ageing
AB PM-JAY was a scheme cited in the discussion on ageing
caf5c7eb1f1b17.x: The schemes cited were NPS Vatsalya and AB PM-JAY, not NP-NCD.

ca435458fcb1a8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's pharmaceutical sector?
o: It is projected to grow from $50 billion to $130 billion by 2030
It provides 40% of the world's vaccines
Branded generics make up 87% of the Indian market
ca435458fcb1a8.x: India provides 50–60% of the world's vaccines, not 40%. The other statements are correct.

ca899b8a0cae0d.s: Under CBSE's two Class 10 exams from 2026–27, students failing in how many subjects can use the second exam?
ca899b8a0cae0d.x: Only compartment students failing in 1–2 subjects can use the second examination; those failing 3 cannot.

cad593d9fa2788.s: According to the Health of the Nation 2025 report, what share of Indians could identify heart symptoms in 2024?
cad593d9fa2788.x: Only 25% of Indians could identify heart symptoms in 2024, not 50%.

caf6f46ae5e4be.s: In the NFSA ration-card verification, MCA data was used to identify:
caf6f46ae5e4be.x: MCA data identified company directors; the Income Tax Department identified taxpayers and MoRTH four-wheeler owners.

cad5ac6fbf292c.s: The amended Schedule I of MGNREGA links minimum water-works spending to which assessment?
o: CGWB Dynamic Ground Water Resources Assessment
cad5ac6fbf292c.x: The amendment is based on the CGWB Dynamic Ground Water Resources Assessment, not the Census of India.

cab2f068971798.s: The Zero Dose Implementation Plan for immunisation was launched in:
cab2f068971798.x: The Zero Dose Implementation Plan dates to 2024; Mission Indradhanush was 2014 and UIP 1985.

ca30bf368cd9bf.s: In the WHO South-East Asia Region (2024), how many pregnant women had hepatitis B?
ca30bf368cd9bf.x: The reported figure for the region was 42 million pregnant women with hepatitis B, not 24 million.

cae1c3b5422435.s: How many Digi Kerala trainees were above 90 years of age?
cae1c3b5422435.x: 15,221 Digi Kerala trainees were above 90 years of age; the programme focused on smartphone-based literacy.

ca5d5a329315b4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Digi Pullampara?
o: It was run in Thiruvananthapuram district
3,300 persons were identified as digitally illiterate
ca5d5a329315b4.x: 3,917 persons were identified as digitally illiterate and 3,300 were trained; the figures are not the same.

ca2266b724e5bb.s: The Washington Group–Short Set for disability data can be aligned with how many categories of the RPwD Act, 2016?
ca2266b724e5bb.x: It can be aligned with the 21 disability categories of the RPwD Act, 2016.

ca0e98a8e10978.s: Census 2011 collected disability data through medical yes/no questions in how many categories?
ca0e98a8e10978.x: Census 2011 used medical binary questions in 8 categories, not functional questions across 21. No dated order exists for a sequence, so this is a one-liner.

cac664ba4b4e94.s: ASHAs were introduced under the National Rural Health Mission in:
cac664ba4b4e94.x: ASHA was introduced under NRHM in 2005; ASHAs are classified as volunteers paid by incentives.

caf1db221d0098.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the HelpAge India study on intergenerational dynamics?
o: 78% of elders cited youth impatience as a concern
78% of youth thought elders lacked digital interest
caf1db221d0098.x: 71%, not 78%, of elders cited youth impatience; 78% was the share of youth who thought elders lacked digital interest.

ca46af1574bbe6.s: India's COVID-19 vaccination drive began on:
ca46af1574bbe6.x: COVID vaccination began on 16 January 2021 and crossed 220 crore doses by January 2023.

cac6cdb4f887e1.s: The National Health Policy that set a public health spending target of 2.5% of GDP was issued in:
cac6cdb4f887e1.x: The National Health Policy dates to 2017; its public health spending target is 2.5% of GDP.

ca3ba0d564136e.s: Who is responsible for deleting ineligible ration cards flagged in the NFSA verification exercise?
ca3ba0d564136e.x: Deletion is the responsibility of States and UTs; the Centre only provides the data.

ca40bd40e994e1.s: According to WHO, how many drugs in developing countries are fake or substandard?
ca40bd40e994e1.x: The WHO estimate is 1 in 10 drugs, not 1 in 20.

ca122676c68826.s: Results of CBSE's mandatory first Class 10 board examination (mid-February) are to be declared by:
ca122676c68826.x: First-exam results come by April; the optional May exam's results come by June.

cab2a14fc2538d.s: The emergency preparedness directive issued amid India–Pakistan tensions included 'CBRN' preparedness. CBRN stands for:
cab2a14fc2538d.x: CBRN = Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear; CBRN preparedness was among the directive's measures.

cacee134e0a232.s: Germany's dual system combines upper-secondary vocational education with:
cacee134e0a232.x: Germany's dual system combines upper-secondary VET with paid apprenticeships; lifelong upskilling and university pathways describe Singapore.

n2a3f6e532dc.s: FIU-IND and SEBI signed an MoU in 2026 for:
n2a3f6e532dc.x: FIU-IND and SEBI cooperate on anti-money laundering; FIU-IND's MoU with I4C targets cyber-financial fraud.

n1040c8f4941.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Khelo India?
o: The revamp adds Khelo India Feeder Schools and Utkrishta Vidyalayas
It targets making India a top-10 sporting nation by 2030
It was revamped by the Cabinet in August 2026
n1040c8f4941.x: The target is a top-10 sporting nation by 2036, not 2030.

nef605551a70.s: The first Vande Bharat Express (2019) ran between:
nef605551a70.x: The first Vande Bharat Express (2019) ran New Delhi – Varanasi, not New Delhi – Katra.

n0d6ea7bd01b.s: Project BHISHM, whose portable cubes work as mobile hospitals, comes under:
n0d6ea7bd01b.x: BHISHM comes under Aarogya Maitri; two of its cubes were given to Sri Lanka.

new.s: Under the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025, the 125 days of guaranteed employment are provided in:
new.x: The 125-day guarantee is in Section 5(1); Section 27 carries the ₹10,000 penalty.

new.s: The penalty under Section 27 of the VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 is:
new.x: Section 27 raised the penalty from ₹1,000 under MGNREGA to ₹10,000.

new.s: Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards under VB-G RAM G, which replace MGNREGA job cards, are valid for:
new.x: VB-G RAM G cards are valid for 3 years, against 5 years for MGNREGA job cards.

new.s: What is the central cost of the VB-G RAM G scheme?
new.x: The central cost is ₹95,692 crore; the total cost is ₹1.51 lakh crore, with about ₹30,000 crore a year falling on States.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about VB-G RAM G:
1. It provides a 60-day pause in peak sowing and harvest seasons.
2. Its allocation is a bottom-up labour budget prepared by Gram Panchayats.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: VB-G RAM G allocation is normative, set by the Centre; the bottom-up labour budget was MGNREGA's.

new.s: The National Rural Livelihoods Mission (2010) was launched by restructuring:
new.x: NRLM was launched in 2010 by restructuring SGSY and was renamed DAY-NRLM in 2016.

new.s: How many Self-Help Groups are covered under DAY-NRLM?
new.x: DAY-NRLM covers 91 lakh SHGs and 10 crore+ households; 5.35 lakh are Village Organisations.

new.s: Ladli Laxmi Yojana, a State DBT scheme for women, belongs to:
new.x: Ladli Laxmi Yojana is Madhya Pradesh's scheme; Ladki Bahin is Maharashtra's and Maiya Samman Jharkhand's.

new.s: Which vaccine is used in India's free nationwide HPV vaccination programme for girls?
new.x: The programme uses single-dose quadrivalent Gardasil; the indigenous Cervavac is not yet WHO-approved for it.

new.s: The first National Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance (NAP-AMR 1.0) was launched in:
new.x: NAP-AMR 1.0 came in 2017; NAP-AMR 2.0 covers 2025–29.

new.s: NDM-1, linked to resistance to carbapenems, stands for:
new.x: NDM-1 is New Delhi Metallo-β-lactamase, giving resistance to β-lactams including carbapenems.

new.s: Kyasanur Forest Disease was first identified in Karnataka in:
new.x: KFD, a tick-borne viral haemorrhagic disease, was first identified in 1957 in Kyasanur Forest, Karnataka.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Kyasanur Forest Disease?
o: It is a tick-borne viral haemorrhagic disease
A vaccine is available against it
A specific antiviral drug is available for it
Its virus belongs to the family Flaviviridae
new.x: There is no antiviral for KFD, although a vaccine is available.

new.s: What is the AYUSH allocation in the Union Budget 2026–27?
new.x: AYUSH got ₹4,408 crore in 2026–27, up from ₹3,992 crore in 2025–26.

new.s: Which of the following systems is NOT part of AYUSH?
new.x: AYUSH covers Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha and Homoeopathy, not Allopathy.

new.s: The NAMASTE scheme, which replaced SRMS, is run by:
new.x: NAMASTE replaced SRMS and is run by NSKFDC (1997), not NSFDC (1989).

new.s: The PM-SURAJ portal, which provides loans up to ₹15 lakh, was launched in 2024 by:
new.x: PM-SURAJ was launched in 2024 by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment (MoSJE).

new.s: What is the PMAY-G target for houses to be built by March 2029?
new.x: PMAY-G targets 4.95 crore houses by March 2029; 3.87 crore+ are sanctioned and 2.95 crore+ completed.

new.s: Which of the following corporations is correctly matched with the year it was set up?
new.x: NSFDC was set up on 8 February 1989; NBCFDC in 1992 and NSKFDC on 24 January 1997.

new.s: What is the full form of ULLAS?
o: Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society
Universal Literacy and Learning for All Students
Understanding Literacy and Learning Among Seniors
new.x: ULLAS stands for Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society, launched in 2022 by the Education Ministry.

new.s: As per PLFS 2023–24, which State has the lowest literacy rate?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh is lowest at 72.6%; Bihar is second lowest at 74.3%.

new.s: SANKALP, launched on 19 January 2018 under MSDE, is assisted by:
new.x: SANKALP is a World Bank-assisted centrally sponsored scheme of MSDE.

new.s: The ONGC–NSTFDC MoU of 5 January 2026 provides ₹28 crore CSR support to:
new.x: ONGC and NSTFDC signed an MoU for ₹28 crore CSR support to Eklavya Model Residential Schools.

new.s: The 'Badhna Hai Toh Yahan Judna Hai' campaign promotes digital skilling through:
new.x: The campaign, launched by Jayant Chaudhary on 22 February 2026, promotes digital skilling via the Skill India Digital Hub (SIDH).

new.s: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper train, flagged off on 17 January 2026, runs between:
new.x: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper runs Howrah – Kamakhya (Guwahati); it was flagged off from Malda Town.

new.s: The first foreign university campus in India under the UGC (2023) regulations is the University of Southampton at:
new.x: The University of Southampton (UK) campus at Gurugram, Haryana was inaugurated on 15 July 2025.

new.s: How many Letters of Intent for foreign university campuses were reported to Parliament in December 2025?
new.x: Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan reported 13 Letters of Intent on 9 December 2025.

new.s: The Atal Pension Yojana is administered by:
new.x: APY, under the Department of Financial Services, is administered by PFRDA.

new.s: Under the Atal Pension Yojana, the monthly pension after age 60 ranges from:
new.x: APY gives a pension of ₹1,000–5,000 a month after 60; ₹42–210 is the contribution when joining at 18.

new.s: A Sukanya Samriddhi account can be opened for a girl below the age of:
new.x: Sukanya Samriddhi is for girls below 10; the account matures in 21 years.

new.s: Womaniya on GeM has signed an MoU with:
new.x: Womaniya on GeM has an MoU with the Women Entrepreneurship Platform (WEP).

new.s: The Bureau of Indian Standards functions under which Ministry?
o: Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
new.x: BIS, headquartered in New Delhi, is under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.

new.s: In the BIS scheme SHINE, the letter 'W' stands for:
new.x: SHINE = Standards Help Inform & Nurture Empowered Women.

new.s: The restructured PM SVANidhi scheme is implemented by:
new.x: PM SVANidhi (nodal MoHUA and DFS) is implemented by SIDBI.

new.s: What is the outlay of the PM SVANidhi scheme extended till 31 March 2030?
new.x: The extended scheme has an outlay of ₹7,332 crore, targeting 1.15 crore beneficiaries.

new.s: Under PM SVANidhi, a street vendor gets a UPI-linked RuPay Credit Card after repaying the:
new.x: The RuPay Credit Card is given after the second tranche is repaid.

new.s: Which Andhra Pradesh district reported 100% tap-water coverage under the Jal Jeevan Mission?
new.x: YSR district has 100% coverage; Palnadu is lowest at 35.55%.

new.s: Under amended Schedule I of MGNREGA, semi-critical blocks must spend at least what share on water works?
new.x: Semi-critical blocks: 40%; over-exploited/critical: 65%; safe: 30%.

new.s: India's last polio case was reported in:
new.x: The last case was on 13 January 2011 in West Bengal; WHO certified the region on 27 March 2014.

new.s: Under the IA2030 framework, a 'zero-dose' child is one who has not received any dose of which vaccine by age one?
new.x: A zero-dose child has received no dose of DTP vaccine by age one.

new.s: India's Universal Immunisation Programme protects against how many diseases?
new.x: UIP covers 12 diseases – 11 nationwide and 1 endemic.

new.s: The Zero Dose Implementation Plan (2024) covers how many districts?
new.x: The plan covers 143 districts in 11 States.

new.s: PMJAY provides health cover of how much per household per year?
new.x: PMJAY (2018) gives ₹5 lakh per household per year for in-patient care.

new.s: The software for PM-BJAP Jan Aushadhi stores is provided by the:
new.x: PM-BJAP's software comes from the Department of Pharmaceuticals; the profit margin is capped at 15%.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about Anshakalin Stri Parichars (ASPs) of Maharashtra:
1. They predate ASHAs.
2. Their wage had been ₹3,000 a month since 2016.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: ASPs are older than ASHAs, and their wage was stuck at ₹3,000 a month since 2016.

new.s: The National Food Security Act, 2013 covers what share of the urban population?
new.x: NFSA covers 75% rural and 50% urban population, 67% overall.

new.s: In the ICMR-INDIAB 2025 survey, how many adults were surveyed?
new.x: The survey covered 1,21,077 adults across 36 States/UTs.

new.s: Which was the first fully literate State under ULLAS?
new.x: Mizoram was first (2024), followed by Tripura and Goa; Himachal Pradesh is the 4th.

new.s: Himachal Pradesh, declared fully literate in 2025, is which fully literate State in order?
new.x: HP is the 4th fully literate State after Mizoram, Tripura and Goa.

new.s: Which is India's first cooperative ride-hailing platform?
new.x: Bharat Taxi is the first cooperative ride-hailing platform.

new.s: Master trainers for Digi Kerala were trained at KILA. KILA stands for:
o: Kerala Institute of Learning and Awareness
new.x: KILA is the Kerala Institute of Local Administration.

new.s: Adi Vaani was launched under Janjatiya Gaurav Varsh by which Ministry?
new.x: The Ministry of Tribal Affairs launched the Adi Vaani beta on 1 September 2025.

new.s: Adi Vishwavidyalaya on the Adi Sanskriti platform is a:
o: Digital tribal art academy with 45 online courses
new.x: Adi Vishwavidyalaya is a digital tribal art academy with 45 online courses; Adi Haat is the marketplace.

new.s: The Forest Rights Act cut-off date for displaced tribals to claim alternative forest land is:
new.x: Under Section 3.1(m) of FRA 2006, tribals displaced before 13 December 2005 get alternative forest land.

new.s: Census 2027 is significant because it will be India's:
new.x: Census 2027 will be India's first digital Census, the first since 2011.

new.s: Which scheme provides aids and appliances such as wheelchairs, hearing aids and Braille slates?
new.x: ADIP gives aids and appliances; the 21 disabilities fall under the RPwD Act and UDID.

new.s: The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 raised the recognised disability categories from 7 to:
new.x: The RPwD Act, 2016 recognises 21 categories, up from 7 in the 1995 Act.

new.s: The 'AI Careers for Women' MoU of April 2025 was signed between MSDE and:
new.x: MSDE signed it with Microsoft (implemented by Edunet Foundation) for 30 Centres of Excellence in women's colleges.

new.s: The MSME Credit Facilitation Programme MoUs with private banks (11 August 2025) were signed by:
new.x: NSIC, under the Ministry of MSME, signed MoUs with Axis, Dhanlaxmi, Karnataka, AU Small Finance and IndusInd banks.

new.s: Which of the following MoU – purpose pairs is correctly matched?
o: DGT–Autodesk – design and make skills in ITIs and NSTIs
NSIC–Axis Bank – AI careers for women
new.x: The DGT–Autodesk MoU (6 November 2025) covers design and make skills in 14,682 ITIs and 33 NSTIs.

new.s: Under the new EPFO norms, withdrawal categories have been reduced from 13 to:
new.x: Withdrawal categories were cut from 13 to 3: essential needs, housing and special circumstances.

new.s: Pension eligibility under the Employees' Pension Scheme requires how many years of pensionable service?
new.x: EPS pension needs 10 years of pensionable service.

new.s: For AP private schools under the RTE quota, children following the State syllabus must complete 5 years by:
new.x: Age 5 must be completed by 1 June for the State syllabus, and by 31 March for IB/CBSE/ICSE.

new.s: PAHAL (DBTL) provides direct benefit transfer of:
new.x: PAHAL transfers the LPG subsidy directly into bank accounts.

new.s: PAHAL (DBTL) was extended to the whole country from:
new.x: PAHAL began in 54 districts on 15 November 2014 and covered the country from 1 January 2015.

new.s: SVAMITVA comes under which Ministry?
new.x: SVAMITVA is a Ministry of Panchayati Raj scheme giving property cards for rural abadi land.

new.s: BHISHM in Project BHISHM stands for:
o: Bharat Health Initiative for Sahyog, Hita and Maitri
Bharat Hospital Infrastructure for Safety and Health Mission
Bharat Health Integrated Support and Humanitarian Mission
Bharat Humanitarian Initiative for Sahayata and Healthcare
new.x: BHISHM = Bharat Health Initiative for Sahyog, Hita and Maitri.

new.s: The Export Promotion Mission (FY26–FY31) of the Ministry of Commerce has an outlay of:
new.x: The Export Promotion Mission has ₹25,060 crore; ₹1 lakh crore is the RDI corpus.

new.s: The Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan aims to train how many grassroots 'Adi Karmayogis'?
new.x: It trains 20 lakh Adi Karmayogis across 1 lakh tribal villages.

new.s: The National Quantum Mission aims to develop machines of:
new.x: NQM (DST, 2023-24 to 2030-31) targets 50–1,000 qubit machines.

new.s: The Gyan Bharatam Mission of the Ministry of Culture has an outlay of:
new.x: Gyan Bharatam has ₹491.66 crore for 2025–31 to digitise 1 crore+ manuscripts.

new.s: The SPM Rurban Mission covers how many clusters?
new.x: The Rurban Mission (2016) covers 300+ clusters; 359 is the number of AP panchayats classed as Rurban.

new.s: Unnat Bharat Abhiyan of MHRD links villages with:
new.x: Unnat Bharat Abhiyan links IITs, NITs and IISERs with villages.

new.s: DIKSHA, under the Ministry of Education, provides:
new.x: DIKSHA offers digital content for school teaching; APAAR is the lifelong student ID.

new.s: What is the total outlay of the revamped Khelo India for 2026-27 to 2030-31?
new.x: ₹29,054 crore plus ₹7,387 crore for National Sports Federations totals ₹36,441 crore.

new.s: Nayi Disha, an initiative to bring school dropouts back, is run by:
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
new.x: Nayi Disha is a Delhi Police initiative, not a central ministry scheme.

new.s: The theme of Har Ghar Tiranga 2026 was:
new.x: Har Ghar Tiranga 2026 (9–17 August) had the theme 'Spirit of Vande Mataram'.

new.s: Ujjwala, merged with Swadhar Greh into Shakti Sadan, was a scheme for:
new.x: This Ujjwala was the anti-trafficking scheme, not PM Ujjwala Yojana (LPG).

new.s: The IVFRT scheme, run by the Bureau of Immigration and NIC, has been extended to:
new.x: IVFRT was extended to March 2031 in April 2026.

new.s: RUSA, the higher-education scheme, now continues as:
new.x: RUSA continues as PM-USHA, which ties grants to NEP 2020 compliance, not Samagra Shiksha.

new.s: The headquarters of the National Turmeric Board is at:
new.x: The National Turmeric Board, set up in January 2025, is headquartered at Nizamabad, Telangana.

new.s: e-Jagriti, launched in January 2025 by the Department of Consumer Affairs, is meant for:
new.x: e-Jagriti handles online consumer complaints; Sampada (Madhya Pradesh) is for property e-registration.

new.s: Under the India–France arrangement of June 2026, an aeronautics skilling centre is set up at:
new.x: India and France agreed on an aeronautics skilling centre at NSTI Kanpur; Kia India funds the ITI at Penukonda.

new.s: Which of the following is a World Bank-aided scheme?
new.x: Atal Bhujal Yojana and Nai Manzil are identified as World Bank-aided.

new.s: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper depot is at:
new.x: The first Vande Bharat Sleeper depot is at Bhagat Ki Kothi, Jodhpur (25 August 2026).

new.s:
Arrange the following in chronological order of launch:
1. Startup India
2. Make in India
3. SVAMITVA
4. Digital India
new.x: Make in India (2014) → Digital India (2015) → Startup India (2016) → SVAMITVA (2020).

new.s: Digital India, launched on 1 July 2015 by MeitY, has how many pillars?
new.x: Digital India has 9 pillars.
